result.description:
Greenmountain Food Processing, a Queensland-based export beef processing facility, is seeking experienced Maintenance Fitters to join our maintenance team at our Coominya facility.

This is a full-time position responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving the mechanical plant, machinery and equipment used throughout our meat processing operation. The successful applicants will work as part of a multidisciplinary maintenance team supporting the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the facility.

Key Responsibilities:

Perform planned, preventative and breakdown maintenance on production machinery and plant equipment
Diagnose mechanical faults and complete repairs in a timely and effective manner
Fit, assemble, install and repair mechanical components and equipment
Overhaul and maintain pumps, gearboxes, bearings, conveyors, hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Read and interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals and maintenance instructions
Carry out fabrication, fitting and minor welding activities where required
Assist with machinery installation, modification and continuous improvement projects
Complete maintenance records and report identified defects
Follow site safety procedures, isolation requirements and permit systems
Maintain a safe, clean and organised work area

Essential Requirements:

Australian-recognised trade qualification in Engineering – Mechanical Trade, Fitting and Turning, or an equivalent relevant qualification
Demonstrated experience working as a Maintenance Fitter, Mechanical Fitter or Fitter-Mechanic
Experience maintaining industrial production machinery and fixed plant
Strong mechanical fault-finding and problem-solving skills
Knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and technical documentation
Ability to work independently and as part of a maintenance team
Strong commitment to workplace health and safety
Availability to work a rotating roster and reasonable overtime required by the operation

Experience within meat processing, food manufacturing, agricultural processing or another high-volume industrial manufacturing environment will be highly regarded.

Salary will be between $79,500 and $85,000 per year, plus superannuation, depending on the applicant’s qualifications, skills and experience.

Only applicants who meet the requirements of the position will be contacted.

result.description:
Causmag International is a leading producer of high-grade magnesium products, supplying critical industries across Australia and beyond. We’re seeking a skilled Mechanical Fitter to help us maintain and enhance our production capabilities through expert machining, assembly, and equipment maintenance located in Young, NSW

Duties and responsibilities
-  Interpret engineering drawings, maintenance manuals, and technical specifications
-  Perform fitting and turning operations to manufacture, modify, and repair mechanical components using lathes, milling machines, drills, and grinders
-  Maintain and repair mechanical plant and equipment including crushers, screens, conveyors, kilns, mills, loaders, pumps, gearboxes, and hydraulic systems
-  Carry out preventative and breakdown maintenance on quarry and processing plant equipment
-  Dismantle, inspect, repair, and reassemble mechanical assemblies 
-  Diagnose mechanical faults and implement corrective actions to minimise downtime
-  Conduct alignment of shafts, bearings, and rotating equipment
-  Perform minor welding, cutting, and fabrication tasks as required and incidental to fitting duties
-  Assist with installation and commissioning of new or upgraded mechanical equipment
-  Ensure machinery operates safely and efficiently within production requirements
-  Maintain tools, workshop equipment, and work areas in safe operating condition
-  Comply with NSW WHS legislation, SWMS, lock-out/tag-out procedures, and site safety systems
-  Complete maintenance records, job cards, and plant service documentation

Key Skills and Attributes:
- Trade qualification as a Fitter and Turner (Cert III or equivalent)  
- Strong understanding of mechanical systems and machining processes  
- Minimum 3 years’ experience with lathe operation and precision fitting  
- A proactive approach to safety and quality  
- Team-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement


Salary range is $65,000 - $85,000 PA commensurate with experience

Fulltime position available

Applications open on 13th July 2026 and closes on 13th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
